chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from some of our companions, from one of them, peace be upon him, who said:
Wearing a garment over the shoulders above wrapping it crosswise in salat (prayer) is disliked, and wrapping it crosswise over the shirt is disliked.

key_terms.التَّوَشُّحِ: wrapping a garment crosswise around the body
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual prayer in which these clothing manners are discussed
key_terms.الِارْتِدَاءُ: wearing a garment over the shoulders in a particular manner
key_terms.الْقَمِيصِ: the shirt or tunic worn beneath

ai.seo_question: What clothing arrangements are considered disliked in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling of karahah regarding certain ways of wearing garments during salat (prayer). It indicates that both placing the garment in the manner of irtida' over tawashshuh, and tawashshuh over a shirt, are disliked forms in prayer.
